manifest.goal: Live-prove that resource capacity and current accepted operators are engine-owned facts distinct from selection and queued work.

native_conformance_exe.result: Native protocol fixtures and semantics passed.

binary_provenance.provenance_result: Kenshi was safely closed before installation; process absence was confirmed; built and installed hashes match; fresh 1.21 telemetry contains world.resource_operators.

snapshots.evidence: Fresh paused 1.21 state had exact selected Ribs and Hand, a Small Iron Resource with operator_capacity 1, current_operator_ids empty and complete, output inventory empty and complete, and no active command. Both characters still had orders and activity for the prior capacity-three resource, proving those channels did not make either an operator of this capacity-one target.

After the exact two-recipient request, the target still reported capacity 1 but current_operator_ids contained only Ribs. Both Ribs and Hand had the exact ordinary OPERATE_MACHINERY order for this target; only Ribs had matching current activity. The command was completed/resource_operator_accepted at engine sequence 803.
Loaded, paused, modal-free final state with active_command_id null. Two selected and two queued identities remained visible while the complete accepted set still contained only Ribs for capacity one.

action.pre_dispatch_state: Snapshot sequence 649; request authored from fresh sequence 749 in the same identity session after the world resumed.
action.request: cmd-06957502b99144479744d93740f998fd perform_context_action operate for selected Ribs and Hand against the exact observed capacity-one Small Iron Resource.
action.later_engine_evidence: Sequence 831 proves selected=[Ribs, Hand], both ordinary queues target the resource, capacity=1, and current_operator_ids=[Ribs]. Selection and queued work therefore cannot be accepted-operator evidence.
action.final_disposition: Recovery completed. Sequence 878 was loaded, paused, modal-free, and active_command_id was null; exact operator state remained visible.

excluded_attempt.disposition: A different candidate had left the current bounded target set. No acceptance or gameplay claim is based on this request; the successful probe rebound to fresh telemetry and a different exact target ID.

Character work channels are separate and cannot substitute for accepted membership.

After a two-recipient request, both identities had queued ordinary work for the target but only Ribs appeared in current_operator_ids.
The native terminal waited until an exact selected identity entered currentOperators and reported resource_operator_accepted.
withheld: No resource-specific assigned-worker list is invented when character task subjects are unresolved.
No work-progress scalar is exported from progressBarLevel, getOutput, productionState, or GUI progress without a proven natural-resource semantic and range.
Operator identities are session-scoped; no cross-load continuity is claimed.
